# Intake review: Fire Station No. 4 Replacement (IFB BF-26-031)

**Recommendation:** Go with conditions.

## Key dates

| Milestone | Date | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Pre-bid conference and site visit (mandatory) | September 22, 2026, 1:30 PM | IFB §3 |
| Last day for questions | October 1, 2026 | IFB §3 |
| Final addendum issued | October 8, 2026 | IFB §3 |
| Bids due | October 15, 2026, 2:00 PM (extended from October 13, 2026 by Addendum 1) | IFB §3; Addendum 1 |
| Anticipated Council award | November 3, 2026 | IFB §3 |

## Project snapshot

New two-story, 16,400 SF fire station for the City of Brannock Falls, design-bid-build, lump sum, engineer's estimate $11,400,000. Architect is Sorensen Vail Architecture PLLC.

## Requirements to bid

- Bid bond of 5% of the total bid (IFB §4).
- Performance and payment bonds at 100% of the contract sum (IFB §4).
- Washington State contractor registration under RCW 18.27 (IFB §5).
- Bidder's Qualification Statement, Section 00 45 13 (IFB §5).
- Prevailing wage applies under RCW 39.12 (IFB §6).
- Non-Collusion Declaration, Section 00 45 19 (IFB §11).
- Insurance including commercial general liability at $2,000,000 per occurrence and $4,000,000 aggregate (IFB §8).

## Risk flags

- Liquidated damages of $3,200 per calendar day after Substantial Completion (IFB §7).
- Asbestos, transite, and lead-based paint abatement of the existing station is in our scope (IFB §9).

## Next steps

Confirm attendance at the pre-bid conference and get the estimating team on the drawings.
